referee_caveats_inferred: Single-pixel photometry of beam-integrated spectra with no aperture correction may bias fluxes where quasar and companion blend at ~1-1.8 arcsec resolution
Dust SED results depend on a tight T_dust prior and on the unstated k_0; L_TIR, SFR and CO(1-0) normalization inherit this
CO SLED normalization uses a dust-derived L_CO(1-0) with an assumed gas-to-dust ratio, making the PDR/XDR conclusion model dependent
Several detections are at 2-4.5 sigma and CLOUDY single-slab models are compared to unresolved multi-phase emission
No CLOUDY scripts or fitting code are provided, limiting independent reproduction of the model grids
